# identities

A table. One row per person/company; identity_key per SPEC §4.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Constraints |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | TEXT | PRIMARY KEY |
| `entity_type` | TEXT | NOT NULL |
| `identity_key` | TEXT | NOT NULL |
| `created_at` | TEXT | NOT NULL |

Table constraints: `UNIQUE(entity_type, identity_key)`.

## Definition

From `spec/ledger.sql`, which is the machine-checkable form of SPEC.md §3:

```sql
CREATE TABLE identities (
  id           TEXT PRIMARY KEY,          -- ULID
  entity_type  TEXT NOT NULL,             -- a type file's name (§4a, ADR-054): person | company | post embedded; more arrive with bindings
  identity_key TEXT NOT NULL,             -- canonical key, see §4
  created_at   TEXT NOT NULL,             -- RFC3339
  UNIQUE(entity_type, identity_key)
);
```
